title: Cerebellar subregions support social cognition in early behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia
title_zh: 小脑亚区在早期行为变异额颞叶痴呆中支持社会认知
abstract: Abstract Social cognitive deficits manifest early in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD), compromising individuals’ ability to interpret social cues, empathize, and maintain interpersonal relationships. Current neurobiological models emphasize cortical network disruption, particularly within the salience, semantic appraisal, and default mode networks, as primary contributors to social dysfunction. However, despite the increasingly recognized role of the cerebellum in higher-order cognitive and socioemotional processes, its contributions to social deficits remains underexplored in bvFTD. Here, we investigated the unique and network-level influences of cerebellar subregions on social cognition across experimental and real-world assessments in early-stage bvFTD. A total of 107 individuals with bvFTD and 100 healthy controls were evaluated across three social domains: theory of mind (ToM) (The Awareness of Social Inference Test-Social Inference-Enriched, TASIT-SIE; Cognitive Emotional Perspective Taking Test), emotion reading (Dynamic Affect Recognition Test; TASIT-Emotion Evaluation Test; Comprehensive Affect Testing System), and real-life empathy (Revised Self-Monitoring Scale; Interpersonal Reactivity Index). Using a functional cerebellar parcellation, we extracted volumes of posterior cerebellar subregions implicated in social-linguistic and multiple-demand networks from participants’ structural MRIs. To address the high collinearity between cerebellar and cortical atrophy patterns, we applied sequential regression, partial least squares correlation, and dominance analysis to characterize brain-behavior relationships. Additionally, supplementary structural equation modelling (SEM) examined whether the associations between cerebellar integrity and social cognition was mediated by executive functioning. Our results showed that cerebellar subregional integrity contributed to social cognitive deficits in individuals with early-stage bvFTD. Cerebellar subregions, particularly right Crus I and II, showed the strongest and most selective contribution to high-level inferential Theory of Mind performance. Tasks involving dynamic emotion stimuli exhibited a more distributed pattern of cerebello-cerebral involvement. By contrast, questionnaire-based measures of real-world social functioning were less prominently represented in the latent covariance structure. SEM further showed that cerebellar integrity remained directly associated with social cognition after accounting for executive functioning, whereas the indirect association through executive functioning was not significant. These findings highlight the task-dependent nature of cerebellar involvement in social cognition, and demonstrate that time-limited experimental tasks, particularly those involving inferential reasoning about beliefs and affect, are likely to be especially valuable in detecting subtle cerebello-cerebral network dysfunction that questionnaire-based measures may overlook. Our results extend cortex-centric models of social dysfunction in bvFTD by demonstrating that cerebellar subregions contribute to distributed cerebello-cerebral systems associated with social cognitive performance. These findings provide a foundation for future longitudinal and mechanistic studies of cerebello-cerebral dysfunction in neurodegenerative disease.
abstract_zh: 摘要 社会认知缺陷在行为变异额颞叶痴呆（bvFTD）早期出现，削弱个体解读社会线索、共情和维持人际关系的能力。当前的神经生物学模型强调皮层网络的破坏，尤其是显著性网络、语义评估网络和默认模式网络，作为社会功能障碍的主要贡献者。然而，尽管小脑在高级认知和社会情感过程中的作用日益受到认可，其对社会缺陷的贡献在bvFTD中仍未得到充分探讨。本文研究了小脑亚区在早期bvFTD中对社会认知的独特和网络层面影响。共107名bvFTD患者和100名健康对照在三大社会领域进行评估：心智理论（ToM）（社会推理意识测试-社会推理增强版，TASIT-SIE；认知情感视角采集测试）、情绪识别（动态情感识别测试；TASIT-情绪评估测试；综合情感测试系统）以及现实生活共情（修订版自我监测量表；人际反应指数）。使用功能性小脑分区，我们从受试者的结构性MRI中提取了与社会语言和多需求网络相关的后小脑亚区体积。为了解决小脑与皮层萎缩模式之间的高度共线性，我们采用了序贯回归、偏最小二乘相关和优势分析来表征脑-行为关系。此外，补充的结构方程模型（SEM）检验了小脑完整性与社会认知之间的关联是否受执行功能的中介。结果显示，小脑亚区完整性对早期bvFTD患者的社会认知缺陷具有贡献。尤其是右Crus I和II亚区对高级推理心智理论表现贡献最强且最具选择性。涉及动态情绪刺激的任务表现出更分布式的小脑-大脑参与模式。相比之下，基于问卷的现实社会功能测量在潜在协方差结构中表现不那么突出。SEM进一步显示，在控制执行功能后，小脑完整性仍与社会认知直接相关，而通过执行功能的间接关联不显著。这些发现强调了小脑在社会认知中的任务依赖性，并表明时间受限的实验任务，尤其是涉及对信念和情感的推理的任务，可能在检测小脑-大脑网络的细微功能障碍方面比问卷测量更有价值。我们的结果通过证明小脑亚区对与社会认知表现相关的分布式小脑-大脑系统的贡献，扩展了以皮层为中心的bvFTD社会功能障碍模型，为未来关于小脑-大脑功能障碍的纵向和机制研究奠定了基础。
